entry_timing.explanation:
Entry timing is a weighted average of independent factors, each scored from -100 (poor moment) to +100 (good moment):

  Bollinger position = 24% of band -> +41 (weight 1.2) - 0% = lower band, 100% = upper band
  MACD divergence (1h) = bearish -> -35 (weight 1.3) - strength 100/100
  MACD divergence (1d) = bearish -> -35 (weight 1.3) - strength 100/100
  range position = lower part of the range -> +30 (weight 1.2) - Buying the lower half of a range is a better entry than the top
  resistance proximity = 23.6% away -> +25 (weight 1.0) - Room before the next resistance
  RSI 1h = 49.7 -> +6 (weight 2.0) - Neutral momentum zone
  RSI daily = 51.0 -> +5 (weight 1.2) - Neutral momentum zone
  distance to EMA20 = -0.51% -> +3 (weight 1.8) - Price 76,438.20 vs EMA20 76,829.52

  weighted sum / total weight (11.0) = +3.9 -> WAIT
  Note: an imminent scheduled macro release is applied as a CAP on the score (weight 0 above), never averaged in - it can only worsen the moment.

Thresholds: >= +45 VERY_FAVORABLE, >= +15 FAVORABLE, -15..+15 WAIT, <= -15 UNFAVORABLE, <= -45 VERY_UNFAVORABLE.
